name: com.fireflower.scrapter
description: A Scratch-style block editor for Unity (the Scraper window) and its runtime: build behaviour out of blocks, save it as a ScrapAsset, and run it on any GameObject with ScrapPlayer. Includes optional feedback, catalog, stat and mob modules. See Documentation~/Guide.md.

samples.description: Play particles by catalog key and fire several feedbacks at once with a FeedbackBinder table.
